decisionSummary: 0.1.27 / appVersion 29 carries the PowerBox targetOrigin fix. The grain posted its grant request to a document.referrer-derived origin, which inside a Sandstorm iframe is the grain's own ui-<hash> origin, so the browser dropped the message, the shell never opened the address-selector, and Claim hung at 'Waiting for approval' forever - the pearl could never reach its sanctions sidecar. Diagnosed from the live browser console on us.paype.cc and fixed to post with '*', matching the working sibling implementation in melusina-app-creeper.
